AppShell.placeholder: Ask about a target, scaffold, or assay; benchmark a series, or run an analysis...

targetBiology: Summarize the genetic evidence linking a kinase target to disease
Map isoform expression across relevant tissues
Compare apo and holo structures for conformational changes
Identify paralogs that could drive off-target activity
hitDiscovery: Design a triage cascade for a high-throughput screen output
Cluster a hit list by scaffold and rank by ligand efficiency
Plan orthogonal confirmation for a set of primary hits
Enumerate a focused virtual library around a fragment hit
medChem: Propose substitutions to improve potency in a lipophilic pocket
Suggest bioisosteres for a metabolically labile amide
Rank scaffold hops that preserve the key hinge interaction
Explore ways to raise sp3 character without losing affinity
dmpkSafety: Predict microsomal stability and human clearance for a series
Flag hERG and CYP inhibition risk across analogs
Compare permeability and efflux liabilities in a matched pair
Estimate oral bioavailability from in vitro inputs
cmc: Outline a scale-up route for a candidate molecule
Plan a salt and polymorph screen
Draft an impurity control strategy for a key step
Recommend formulation options for early tox studies
